months.question: When should you refuse what is pleasant for what is good?
months.why: Short enough to finish in a month. Freely available in Sanskrit with translations on the Gita Supersite; we name the translation we use in the guide.

sessions.where: Video call · link sent on sign-up

guide.title: What to read
guide.text: The Katha Upanishad, the Nachiketa story and Yama's teaching. Translation: [NAMED TRANSLATION, edition]. Sanskrit text: Gita Supersite.

guide.title: Before you start
guide.text: The Upanishads are among the oldest philosophical texts in India. This one is told as a story: a boy, his father, and Death. Read the story first, then the teaching.

guide.title: Words to know
guide.text: śreyas (the good) · preyas (the pleasant) · ātman (the self) · brahman (ultimate reality)

guide.title: Questions to bring
guide.text:
1. Was Nachiketa right to keep questioning his father?
2. Why does Yama test him before answering?
3. Name one "pleasant" thing you'd find hard to give up for something "good".
